description: This file defines a repository interface for the User entity, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide data access methods such as findByUsername and existsByUsername.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entities, providing methods for finding users by username and checking username existence.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User object wrapped in an Optional by username.

methods.name: existsByUsername
methods.description: Checks if a user exists with the given username.
